resources.string: Apple light and dark artwork · per-app mappings
Build a static pack for matched apps. Light and dark artwork are fetched together; apps without a separate dark icon keep their original artwork. No continuous icon renderer is added.
512/1024 px recommended; 256 px may look soft.
Rounded uses the Apple platform shape; Original preserves the source image shape.
%1$d of %2$d installed apps mapped · tap to preview

Tap an app to preview, replace or exclude its Apple icon. Manual choices take priority and save the storefront per app and platform, so different regions can be mixed. Changes take effect after generating and applying the pack.
iPadOS uses App Store artwork shared with iOS. Search results are limited to apps available for iPad.
There are pending changes. Generate incrementally to update the pack.
Reuses artwork across apps and generations. Clearing downloads keeps your mappings and the generated pack.
Refresh store metadata, then download changed or missing artwork only. Requests are paced; you can cancel.
Generated: %1$d apps, %2$d with dark artwork. %3$d cached pairs reused; %4$d apps unavailable. Preview and apply the pack below.
No artwork changes: %1$d apps, %2$d with dark artwork. %3$d cached pairs reused; %4$d apps unavailable. The existing pack is retained.
Choose the Apple artwork to use for %1$s. Check the publisher and bundle ID; unrelated apps may have similar names.
App name or Apple App Store ID
Do not use an Apple icon for this app
No matching apps in this platform and region. Try another name or change the platform or region.
Apple is limiting requests. Downloaded artwork is retained; try again later.
No apps are mapped. Open Custom mappings to choose Apple icons first.
Could not fetch Apple artwork. Check the network, platform and region. Your existing pack and downloads are safe.
Could not prepare this pack. Your existing pack and mappings are retained.
Some icons use cached or standard store artwork. Check again later for native light and dark updates.
This pack exceeds the size limit. Reduce resolution or the number of mappings.
Manage downloaded artwork from Apple icon pack. Generated packs and mappings are kept separately.
Some Apple system icons and Apple Music are included for offline use. Artwork belongs to Apple and the app publishers; independent dark availability is checked from decoded pixels.
Original artwork may not include a separate dark variant. Rounded can provide a native dark rendition for some apps.
